crm_notes:
Summary: evaluating Redwood Dedicated for real-time agent assist + ticket summarization. UmbraCore builds an agent desktop for 600+ contact center seats; want streaming suggestions (token-level UI), deterministic guardrails, and tool-calling to their CRM (open/close tickets).

Recent activity:
- 2025-01-20: intro call w/ AE (Maya) + PM (R. Santos). overview of platform, high level SLA ask.
- 2025-02-05: SE deep-dive w/ Liam. reviewed batching, KV cache, and quantization tradeoffs. identified potential perf wins on short-context models.
- 2025-02-18: POC kickoff (Fireflies ff_20250218_umbracore_kickoff). defined acceptance criteria: p95 latency <200ms for suggestion response under baseline load; p95 <350ms during 3x spike; no PII leakage; tool-calls complete <500ms end-to-end.
- 2025-02-27: security questionnaire submitted (drive://security/umbracore-security-faq.pdf). SOC2 in progress on their side; legal flagged residency for EU customers.
- 2025-03-01: spike-test planning meeting (Fireflies ff_20250301_spike-test-planning). agreed to run dedicated pool with autoscale disabled to measure graceful degradation and fallback to smaller model variants.

Requirements / notes from stakeholders:
- "We need streaming suggestions that feel instant to agents — target p95 <200ms, ideally <150ms for short replies." — Head of Product.
- Must support tool-calling: Close ticket, add note, escalate to supervisor. webhook-based and JS SDK integration required.
- Guardrails: hallucination detection, citation of knowledge base entries for agent suggestions, allow agent feedback loop (thumbs up/down) to feed Optimize pipeline.
- Compliance: SOC2 + SSO (SAML), audit logs for every model call, KMS for keys, retention controls for transcripts, EU data residency for EU contact centers.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for predictable latency, but want Optimize recommendations to keep token costs reasonable.

POC acceptance criteria (short):
- Streaming suggestion delivered token-by-token; first-token latency <120ms baseline.
- p95 response <200ms baseline; under 3x concurrent spike p95 <350ms or graceful fallback to cached/faster model with clear signal to agent.
- Tool-calls from suggestion UI complete <500ms and propagate to CRM (ticket state updated).
- No high-severity security findings in initial review; encryption in transit + at rest; audit logging accessible via Console.

Open items / blockers:
- Legal needs explicit data residency plan for EU region (blocked until response from infra).
- SOC2 timeline unclear — procurement wants SOC2 or equivalent in 3 months.
- Integration complexity: legacy agent toolbar only accepts synchronous HTTP calls; need Redwood SDK pattern for safe async tool-calling.

Next steps (short):
- SE (Liam) to run dedicated pool spike test w/ UmbraCore test harness week of 2025-03-10.
- Deliver POC runbook + rollback/fallback policy by 2025-03-07 (drive link).
- Legal to provide residency answers by 2025-03-14.

Internal notes (AE): keep pricing flexible — recommend annual reserved plan for dedicated with burst credits. emphasize Optimize to reduce token spend. Flag as potential expansion to Private if residency/legal blocks persist.
notes_summary: Engaged mid-market contact center platform evaluating Redwood Dedicated for token-level streaming suggestions, low-latency SLOs, and secure tool-calling. POC defined; spike test scheduled; SOC2/residency are main blockers.
